decision.m4bInterpretation: M4B is not required as fixed translated text. TargetQualityName is dynamic-data passed as {value0}; each caller uses the configured value or the fallback string M4B. When the configured value is absent, the runtime fallback is preserved by {value0}. If a configured target differs, hardcoding M4B is inaccurate.
decision.metadataConsistency: The registry protectedLiterals array contains M4B although the English source, parameterized pattern, and source template contain no M4B literal. This appears inconsistent if protectedLiterals means text that must occur literally in every target. It may be documenting the callsite fallback, but that fallback is dynamic and belongs inside {value0}.
decision.literalCheckPolicy: Treat {value0} as the required preserved token. Do not require an extra M4B literal in every locale. A target may render M4B via the runtime value when the fallback is used.
decision.placeholderCheck: All 12 current values contain exactly one {value0} placeholder and no other brace tokens. Every proposed target also retains exactly one {value0}.
